message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on June 18, 1815, resulted in roughly **25,000 total casualties** (killed, wounded, missing) across both sides. In more detail:

| Side | Casualties (approx.) |
|------|----------------------|
| French & allies | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian coalition | ~22,000 |

These figures are rounded estimates; exact numbers vary slightly among contemporary reports and modern scholarship.
